result.topic_en: Euler compares the fundamental tone of an elastic rod free at both ends with that of a rod fixed at one end (ratio 25:36, a false fifth), then gives the general superposition of all vibration modes and begins examining the shape of the rod sounding its principal tone.

items.english: That if a rod free at both ends gives the tone g, then the same rod simply fixed at one end will at once give the lower tone C-sharp, which can easily be confirmed by experiment.
